If you’ve been here a while you know they havnt been afraid to make drastic changes to Traphase before. (Typically catastrophic) The shift is just them lying through their teeth.
can you guys tell me how to counter Glotan? I feel she is so annoying right now

as someone playing Glotan after boycotting glotan. Someone here said “just play glotan if you’re complaining about losing to glotan.” I really took it to heart.
My biggest fears in matches are Agrippa, Erica, Tulu.

It be like that. I changed my name to GLotan cheats and play GLotan.

If you don’t let her sit on cards, you’re somewhat winning. Paralysis, the discard/draw posse - ultra one with a top hat (is it happy magic show?) can be somewhat effective I think. Run paralysis though.

Personally, you kill her before she could kill you.

There's multiple ways to achieve this and I kinda always do it:
- MANDATORYISH: usually they save up their 3cost for ult. So I have that gate of truth(?) (I forgot, it's the gate) where you can get 2 of their highest arith cards. They usually seem to have that.
- have 1 char that applies weakness (could just be pollux...) and one that stuns (like aigis) so u can stun their tinct/doll/casiah as you do your stuff

Not mandatory, pick your poison
- If those teams have no debuffers, pollux can crush her to death (depending on luck)
- vortice + deepsea and if you're lucky enough to get 5costs + deepsea at turn 1 or near that, you're gonna do wonderfully (unless they have clementine but they usually do not)
- pickman also helps with this stuff. I once literally nuked an entire team w/ him (extra thanks to glotan 3cost)
- your typical helot + gmurph can also work if you could speedrun it
Clem is a pretty good counter to glotan in my experience
so.. if i don't have one of those units i can only pray that i won't meet the Glotan team?
There are probably better strategists than me but for me...well you either counter w glotan or get fucked
Just had a thought to come back and mention void is effective too.
Daff can easily sniper her too (unless she plays will unyielding and alot of players do)
Cynthia, whoever you are; i’m sorry for this madness.
